reason: It's brand new, so there are no Play ratings or Reddit threads for me to check, and I'm not paying for anything I can't read reviews on first. At most I'd poke at the free tier with a syllabus PDF, and on $4,000 a year the free version would have to fail me before I'd even think about $6.
objection: Will the AI actually read my receipt and syllabus right, or will I spend more time fixing its mistakes than I would just typing it in myself?
would_change_my_mind: A bunch of real reviews from other U of U students saying it read their receipts and syllabi correctly without much fixing, plus a student price around $2 to $3 a month.
